title: New Line will not save without a Title and says "Title is a required field"
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create an open work order for this test, work order 1, so that a wrongly saved line would not touch other work.
  • Start on work order 1, on its Lines tab.
custom_steps:
1. Click New Line.
  2. Click the Description box.
  3. Type "no title".
  4. Click Save & Close.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The New Line window opens over work order 1, with an empty Title field.

Step 2:

  • You have left the empty Title field: "Title is a required field" shows under the Title box (not "Line Name is a required field").

Step 3:

  • "no title" shows in the Description box.

Step 4:

  • The window stays open and the line is not saved.
  • "Title is a required field" shows under the Title box (not "Line Name is a required field").
  • The Description box still holds "no title".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "What Are You Doing / Why Are You Doing It?" (Title and Description), Confluence 845348896, version 15 (14 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11257, story SV-10130 (Story 1, The Work Order Line Dialog)

  • S1-R6: “Leaving Title empty blocks the save with the message "Title is a required field", replacing "Line Name is a required field". Every required-field message in the app uses the "X is a required field" form, and this one keeps it. The message shows under the Title box whenever Title is in error, including when the user leaves it empty, the same as every other field in the dialog (SV-10916).”
  • S1-R7: “Nothing else about the dialog changes, other than the label position in S1-R3: same fields in the same order, same validation, same values saved.”

Not yet checked against a build by us: the QA build (sv10130.qa.shopview.com, QuickBooks host qb1.qa.shopview.com) and staging carry this change, and this case has not been run on either.
